policy_extraction.issuing_body: National Information Society Agency (NIA), South Korea
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a casebook documenting pilot/proof-of-concept AI service implementations across Korean public sector agencies under three strategic goals: social problem solving, public service innovation, and improving administrative work methods. Cases span 2023-2025 and involve large language model fine-tuning, RAG architectures, and multimodal AI. No binding obligations, prohibitions, or enforcement mechanisms are established; the document serves as a knowledge-sharing and demonstration resource.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is a South Korean government casebook showcasing 110 public AI service pilots organized under three strategic goals: solving social problems, innovating public services, and improving work methods. The dominant framing is social stability—AI is deployed to address social care gaps (elderly, disabled, children), low birth rates, welfare blind spots, crime prevention, and disaster management. Consumer/public safety is a secondary frame given the focus on healthcare, traffic safety, and disaster response. Innovation enablement is also secondary as the document promotes AI adoption across government agencies.
